sections.en: 1 θηρίων ('of wild beasts') A. 2 ἐξ ἧς ('from which') A. 4 Marcianum 335 (A) described by Olivieri; Parisinum 2506, f. 23r (B) collated by Cumont. 5 σχήματος ('of the figure') A : διαμέτρ(ου) ('of the diameter') B. 9 τρίγωνον δεσπό- ('trine lord') την καὶ ὁριοκράτορα ('and term ruler') A. 12 κατὰ ('according to') written above by B. διέκβαλλον ('they cast out') A. καὶ ('and') omitted by B. 13 σκορπίον ('Scorpio') : σκόπει ('examine') conjectured by Kroll. παραλήψεις ('you will receive') A which Kroll approves. 14 δʹ ('4') from βʹ ('2') corrected by B. ἐπιμερισμένης ('apportioned') as it seems B : τοὺς ἐπιμερισμοὺς ('the apportionments') conjectured by Kroll. 16 νυκτὸς ('of night') ὁρίοις τοῦ Ἄρεως καὶ Κρόνου ('in the terms of Mars and Saturn') B. 18 πατραλλοῖαι ('parricides') the codices have. 19 ἀστέρα ('star') omitted by B (ἀστέρα ('star') is inept; corrected to ἐπίκεντρον ('at the angle') ? by Kroll). After μητροκτόνοι ('matricides') a space of five letters B. 20 ἢ τὸν κύριον τοῦ κλήρου ('or the lord of the lot') after γίνονται ('they become') transposed by B. To be bracketed ? 21 ἐχθροὺς ποιοῦσι ('they make enemies') the codex has. 24 εἰ δὲ ('but if') corrected ; οἱ δὲ ('but the') B : οἱ ('the') A. 25 δορυφορίας ('of the spear-bearing') conjectured by Kroll.

summary.headline: Astrology of the Parents
summary.text: Astrological doctrine concerning parents, assigning the father to the Sun and Saturn and the mother to the Moon and Venus, with lots, house-masters, trigon-masters, and bound-rulers. Configurations involving Mars, Saturn, Jupiter, the lights, aspects, and lots are said to indicate patricide, matricide, hostility, discord, friendship, fortune, and the timing of parental matters.
